name: Windows compliance
description: Personal desktop compliance: a supported Windows 11 build and a running antivirus that registers with Windows Security Center (Microsoft Defender or a third-party product). Devices are marked noncompliant straight away when a check fails.
portalPath: Intune admin center > Devices > Compliance > Create policy > Windows 10 and later > System Security: Antivirus = Require; Device Properties: Minimum OS version = 10.0.26100; Actions for noncompliance: Mark device noncompliant, 0 days
reviewNotes: The antivirus check reads Windows Security Center, so a third-party product that registers there counts. Defender-only checks (real-time protection, signatures) are left out on purpose.
BitLocker, Secure Boot and code integrity checks need Device Health Attestation and are left out. Add them only after testing them on your VM SKU.
Decide the tenant setting 'Mark devices with no compliance policy assigned as' separately. It affects every device in the tenant.
If Conditional Access will require compliant devices, start it in Report-only and check the results first.
